# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and university student  <sub>[v3 c9 P5](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0005), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a dark-eyed girl who is considered strikingly attractive, possessing a 'rose-red' beauty. Despite her attractive looks, she does not consider herself remarkably pretty when compared to others.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c22 P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v3 c4 P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004), [v3 c5 P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel has a heart brimming with yearning dreams, imaginations, and poetic sensibilities, though she can occasionally be cynical or unsparing in her critiques. She expresses frustration with the exhausting realities of teaching, yet possesses a great capacity for humor and enjoyment of life among her friends. She values deep, quiet friendship and appreciates beauty, despite sometimes doubting her own accomplishments.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P5](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0005), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P15](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0015), [v3 c10 P48](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0048), [v3 c13 P21](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0021)_

## Goals

- to keep house with her college friends and Aunt Euphemia  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended Regent's Academy, where she became close friends with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. After graduating, she taught for two years in an isolated rural school, where she grew exhausted by the demanding expectations of the community and students' parents. Tired of boarding and teaching, she decided to attend Wexcombe College to join the Sophomore class. She proposed that she, Nell, and Honora lease a small house in Portmaris called Tabby's Place, inviting her Aunt Euphemia to act as housekeeper. Along with Cressida Lindsay, the group lived together during their remaining university years. At Wexcombe, Mabel pursued her studies, took part in the Philomathic Society, and successfully completed her courses.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P5](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0005), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P15](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0015), [v3 c10 P33](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0033), [v3 c37 P28](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0028)_
